method: Re-opened hash-verified archived PDFs via PdfReader independently of producer page cache; inspected physical statement pages, current/prior year headings, RMB thousands and explicit per-share exception, individual row labels and current column values, unlabeled block subtotals, stock/flow periods and signed expenses. Decimal cross-statement reconciliation. Candidate files were read only; admission remains a separate operation.

cash_reconciliation_evidence.closing_row: Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the year 24(a) 30,230,147 11,563,282

limitations: Source extraction review, not an audit of issuer truth or a claim of full research input completeness.
Property/equipment cash payments and weighted average shares are not present in this candidate set.
Current borrowings include any current portion; non-current borrowings exclude separately disclosed instruments.
Receivables basis is accounts-only through 2022 and explicitly trade-and-notes in 2023; comparability needs that basis.
2018/2019 source income statement discloses net finance income; preserved under finance-income-net, not gross finance costs. Gross finance costs remain missing in this extraction.
